note: Childress County, TX: no county zoning layer (Texas counties generally do not zone). City of Childress has an official zoning map (Municode Chapter 54, s.54-178) but publishes no queryable zoning service; its maps page links only a PRPC viewer and CAD annotations. PRPC GIS downloads contain roads, addresses and boundaries, no zoning. Commercial parcel vendors (Regrid) show no zoning coverage. No ArcGIS Online zoning layer for Childress found; the Zoning_Districts service at services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd is another jurisdiction's (chapter 56 codes, not Childress).
